modules.name: Identity and role access
modules.description: Signs in a verified QCU account and presents the functions allowed for its role.
modules.coreFunctionality: Authentication; role dashboard; permission checks.

modules.name: Profiles and personnel directory
modules.description: Shows verified role identity and an institutional directory for CCS, Guidance, and OSAS.
modules.coreFunctionality: Role badge; professional/educational profile; directory search; QCU email contact.

modules.name: CCS feed and announcements
modules.description: Provides CCS-wide discussions and official announcements to every role.
modules.coreFunctionality: Read feed; search/filter by scope and label; view announcement priority.

modules.name: AI navigation assistant
modules.description: Answers system-scoped questions and assists with navigation, schedules, report drafting, and milestone explanations.
modules.coreFunctionality: FAQ; search guidance; schedule parsing; contextual assistance.

modules.name: Role-aware notifications
modules.description: Delivers relevant announcements, messages, consultation changes, report replies, and case milestones.
modules.coreFunctionality: Priority tiers; inbox; read state; link to source item.

modules.name: Section and subject membership
modules.description: Gives a student access to the sections and subjects in which they are enrolled.
modules.coreFunctionality: View membership; enter section/subject spaces; join associated group chat.

modules.name: Discussion participation
modules.description: Lets students create, read, and comment on discussions in permitted spaces.
modules.coreFunctionality: Post/comment; choose label; optional anonymous display; search/filter.

modules.name: Student messaging
modules.description: Allows direct messages to professors and peers and participation in class group chats.
modules.coreFunctionality: Direct chat; section/subject group chat; message notifications.

modules.name: Student calendar
modules.description: Shows faculty availability and institutional events with a personal task calendar.
modules.coreFunctionality: Switch calendars; inspect event details; add personal to-do items.

modules.name: Consultation requests
modules.description: Lets students request professor consultation slots and track approval through completion.
modules.coreFunctionality: Browse slots; submit request; view requested/approved/booked/completed/cancelled status.

modules.name: Incident report submission
modules.description: Lets students file a named or anonymous concern with category and severity.
modules.coreFunctionality: Draft; categorize; classify severity; submit; receive report ID.

modules.name: Progressive anonymity
modules.description: Lets a student start a confidential conversation anonymously and disclose identity when ready.
modules.coreFunctionality: Identity visibility control; secure conversation; disclosure step.

modules.name: Discussion-to-report conversion
modules.description: Offers the discussion author a choice to turn a high-engagement concern into a report.
modules.coreFunctionality: Flag possible concern; measure engagement; prompt author; convert on consent.

modules.name: Report and case timeline
modules.description: Shows a student the status and responsible office of their own active reports and Case Files.
modules.coreFunctionality: Status; milestone history; office; timestamps; priority notifications.

modules.name: Student faculty evaluation
modules.description: Collects the semestral faculty evaluations assigned to the student's section.
modules.coreFunctionality: Open assigned form; submit answers; show completion state.

modules.name: Account standing view
modules.description: Shows a neutral standing badge and applicable feature restrictions to the student.
modules.coreFunctionality: Standing badge; restriction notice; continued essential access.

modules.name: Notification preferences
modules.description: Lets students prioritize report and case updates above general academic messages.
modules.coreFunctionality: Preference settings; urgent report replies; case milestone alerts.

modules.name: Organization space
modules.description: Provides a distinct CCS organization community and verified visual identity.
modules.coreFunctionality: Member space; discussion feed; member access.

modules.name: Organization announcements
modules.description: Lets authorized organization representatives communicate events and announcements.
modules.coreFunctionality: Publish organization updates; attach event details; notify members.

modules.name: Teaching roster
modules.description: Shows students enrolled in the professor's assigned sections and subjects.
modules.coreFunctionality: Roster view; section filter; subject filter.

modules.name: Class and faculty discussion
modules.description: Lets professors post and converse in their classes and CCS faculty space.
modules.coreFunctionality: Post/comment; class announcements where authorized; faculty feed.

modules.name: Professor messaging
modules.description: Supports direct messages and section group chats with students and colleagues.
modules.coreFunctionality: Direct chat; class chat; notifications.

modules.name: Availability management
modules.description: Lets professors publish and change available consultation slots.
modules.coreFunctionality: Create/edit availability; block unavailable times; calendar sync.

modules.name: Consultation decisions
modules.description: Lets professors process student consultation requests and record outcomes.
modules.coreFunctionality: Approve/decline; book; complete; cancel.

modules.name: Assigned grievance queue
modules.description: Shows reports routed to a professor or adviser for response.
modules.coreFunctionality: Assigned queue; report view; response; action history.

modules.name: Faculty evaluation participation
modules.description: Lets professors submit peer and upward evaluations using duty-aligned criteria.
modules.coreFunctionality: Peer form; Program Chair/Dean form; completion.

modules.name: Own evaluation summary
modules.description: Provides a professor with a summary of their faculty evaluation results.
modules.coreFunctionality: Read summary; identify feedback themes.

modules.name: Staff workspace
modules.description: Gives staff a role-specific view of CCS-wide discussions, announcements, and assigned communications.
modules.coreFunctionality: Read permitted feeds; contact personnel; use approved staff actions.

modules.name: Program dashboard
modules.description: Shows sections, reports, and activity for the chair's assigned program.
modules.coreFunctionality: Program filtering; section oversight; report summary.

modules.name: Conflict-aware report intake
modules.description: Receives reports that bypass an adviser due to a detected conflict or are escalated from the first stage.
modules.coreFunctionality: Conflict queue; triage; action; escalation.

modules.name: Program grievance analytics
modules.description: Displays bottlenecks, escalation counts, and resolution rates within the chair's program.
modules.coreFunctionality: Metrics; status filter; case drill-down.

modules.name: Program evaluation oversight
modules.description: Lets chairs participate in faculty evaluation and review program-scoped summaries.
modules.coreFunctionality: Evaluation participation; summary review.

modules.name: Authorized offense view
modules.description: Shows detailed student offense records when needed for program authority.
modules.coreFunctionality: First-to-third offense record view; standing context.

modules.name: Chair communication
modules.description: Lets the chair communicate with faculty and, when permitted, students.
modules.coreFunctionality: Direct messages; program posts; calendar access.

modules.name: Similar-report consolidation
modules.description: Summarizes highly similar reports and both supporting and dissenting sentiments for authorized review.
modules.coreFunctionality: Similarity grouping; sentiment summary; source links.

modules.name: College oversight dashboard
modules.description: Shows cross-program activity, case summaries, bottlenecks, and resolution metrics.
modules.coreFunctionality: College-wide filters; metrics; authorized drill-down.

modules.name: Dean escalation queue
modules.description: Receives grievances escalated beyond Program Chair and formal case summaries requiring Dean review.
modules.coreFunctionality: Escalated queue; action; onward referral.

modules.name: Semestral evaluation administration
modules.description: Configures, deploys, and monitors student and faculty evaluations.
modules.coreFunctionality: Questions; instructions; criteria; publication state; completion monitoring.

modules.name: College evaluation results
modules.description: Provides published faculty and leadership evaluation summaries across CCS.
modules.coreFunctionality: Aggregate results; underperformance review; follow-up context.

modules.name: Authorized disciplinary view
modules.description: Shows detailed first-to-third offense records for students under Dean authority.
modules.coreFunctionality: Offense history; standing; restriction status.

modules.name: Dean communication and calendar
modules.description: Lets the Dean post discussions, message faculty, and inspect events and availability.
modules.coreFunctionality: College post; permitted direct chat; calendar view.

modules.name: Role and system configuration
modules.description: Manages platform roles and relevant system settings.
modules.coreFunctionality: Role assignment; permission configuration; audit trail.

modules.name: Content moderation
modules.description: Reviews posts or messages flagged by AI or user reports for harmful content.
modules.coreFunctionality: Flag queue; review; disposition; author notice.

modules.name: Feature restriction administration
modules.description: Applies or lifts specific interaction restrictions on authorized decision.
modules.coreFunctionality: Restrict posting/commenting/anonymous reporting; lift; notify.

modules.name: Audit and adoption monitoring
modules.description: Shows platform use, permission actions, and operational logs.
modules.coreFunctionality: Adoption counts; audit interface; system status.

modules.name: Chatbot and uptime monitoring
modules.description: Tracks assistant use and platform availability.
modules.coreFunctionality: Activity counts; error view; uptime status.

modules.name: Reported-content validation
modules.description: Validates a user report about a post or comment before any grievance escalation.
modules.coreFunctionality: Review report; classify; dismiss or refer.

modules.name: Case File intake
modules.description: Receives reports transferred to Guidance and converts them into formal Case Files.
modules.coreFunctionality: Intake queue; case conversion; milestone creation.

modules.name: Guidance case handling
modules.description: Records Guidance interventions, resolutions, and authorized transfers.
modules.coreFunctionality: Case notes; milestone updates; resolve/escalate.

modules.name: Offense and Good Moral support
modules.description: Shows authorized offense details and Good Moral prerequisite status.
modules.coreFunctionality: Offense view; compliance review.

modules.name: Restriction oversight
modules.description: Reviews feature restrictions for flagged students within Guidance authority.
modules.coreFunctionality: Restriction status; review; referral for apply/lift.

modules.name: Guidance communication and calendar
modules.description: Lets Guidance officers communicate with authorized faculty and view institutional dates and availability.
modules.coreFunctionality: Direct messages; permitted discussion posts; calendar view.

modules.name: OSAS case intake and handling
modules.description: Receives formal cases transferred to OSAS and records student affairs actions.
modules.coreFunctionality: Stage queue; case action; milestone; resolution or transfer.

modules.name: Offense tracking
modules.description: Views detailed student offense records for authorized student affairs work.
modules.coreFunctionality: First-to-third offense history; standing review.

modules.name: Good Moral and restriction oversight
modules.description: Reviews compliance prerequisites and feature restrictions for flagged students.
modules.coreFunctionality: Compliance review; restriction oversight; permitted change/referral.

modules.name: OSAS communication and calendar
modules.description: Lets OSAS staff communicate with authorized faculty and view institutional calendars.
modules.coreFunctionality: Direct messages; discussion post; events/availability view.

modules.name: Executive case intake
modules.description: Receives only cases escalated to the President's Office stage.
modules.coreFunctionality: Executive queue; case summary; route history.

modules.name: Executive case action
modules.description: Records authorized President's Office action and final case progression.
modules.coreFunctionality: Review; record action; return/resolve/transfer as permitted.
